plan_item: 77.44.7.D / D-02 — safe persisted labels in Page Action Inspector

change.summary: Inspector choice labels now accept only trimmed strings or finite numbers before formatting. Malformed persisted node/tab labels receive bounded safe fallback text and cannot invoke arbitrary toString coercion while rendering a valid Page Action target.
change.regression: Real Chromium reloads the saved editor draft with a tab title {toString:null}, reopens the Page Action inspector, selects the valid same-page target, checks fallback labels and no pageerror, then repairs the text through the existing content editor before exercising the rest of the Save/Preview/Publish lifecycle.
change.save_publish: Save remains draft-only; Preview reads the draft; Publish remains a separate action. The existing browser lifecycle test asserts this distinction.
